# The wind pennant: a crimson wedge 1.3 m long pointing +X from the pole, 0.6 m tall at the pole,
# 0.1 thick; origin at the pole (its top). The game turns it downwind and droops it in a calm.
new
material new Flag --base-color 0.7882 0.1412 0.3922 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Flag --vertices 3 --radius1 0.36 --radius2 0 --depth 1.3 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.28 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 90 0
set location 0.65 0 -0.3
apply --location --rotation
material assign Flag
select all
shade flat
export flag.glb
